snippet.title: Roughly Crafted | Gameplay Trailer | Gamflix
snippet.description:
Roughly Crafted is a craftsman simulator where you slap together monster bits and odd materials into one-of-a-kind weapons. Run your own shop: experiment with designs, bargain with adventurers, and grow your collection of crafting parts. Remember: the right tool can save a hero’s quest!

Minimum:
OS: Windows 10
Processor: Intel i3-6100 or equivalent
Memory: 1 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 / Radeon HD 7970
DirectX: Version 10
Storage: 1 GB available space

Minimum:
OS: High Sierra 10.13+
Processor: 1.8 GHz or faster processor (Apple Silicon & Intel supported)
Memory: 1 GB RAM
Graphics: Metal or OpenGL 3
Storage: 1 GB available space
